title: PayoutPaid
description: A payout reached the carrier's card.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

user_id.description: The person who asked, to whose card the money goes.

amount.description: What left the carrier's available card income, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

fee.description: The transfer fee kept from it, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

net.description: What the card receives, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).
